product_overview: Advus is a web platform to centralize and modernize law firm operations — consolidating clients, legal processes, financial records and high-level operational insights into a single responsive interface.
core_goals: Centralize client records and histories so users can view all processes, notes and financial links per client.
Track and manage legal processes using a Kanban-style workflow to monitor status and deadlines.
Register and review financial transactions (revenues, expenses) and maintain a clear cashflow ledger.
Provide a concise operational dashboard that surfaces metrics, deadlines and recent activity for quick decision-making.

features.name: Platform Branding & UI
features.description: Consistent Advus visual identity across the app that surfaces a rebranded welcome experience and unified navigation so users recognize product state and key metrics at a glance.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /app/dashboard -> View rebranded Welcome overlay on login -> View unified sidebar and topbar -> Check metrics cards with glassmorphism

features.name: Dashboard - Overview & Interaction
features.description: High-level workspace showing stats, upcoming deadlines and recent activity with interactive blocks users can reorder and use to jump into detailed records.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /app/dashboard -> View stats, deadlines, and recent activity -> Drag and drop blocks to reorder -> Toggle financial values visibility -> Click on cards to navigate

features.name: Client Management
features.description: Create and manage client records (individuals and companies) and review each client's linked processes, notes and financial records in one place.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /app/clientes -> Create a new client with required data (CPF or CNPJ) -> Save client -> See new client listed -> Open client to view associated processes, notes and financial records

Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /app/clientes -> Attempt to create a client without required CPF/CNPJ -> See validation error preventing save

features.name: Process Management (Kanban)
features.description: Track legal processes using a Kanban board where users can add processes with case details and move them through status columns to reflect progress.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /app/processos -> Create a new process with number, tribunal, area and responsible -> Save process -> See process appear on the Kanban board

Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /app/processos -> Drag and drop a process card to a different status column -> See process reflect the new status

features.name: Financial Management
features.description: Record and review financial movements including revenues and expenses to maintain a clear cashflow and per-client financial linkage.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /app/financeiro -> Record a revenue entry with amount, date and category -> Save entry -> See entry listed in the ledger and reflected in cashflow summary

Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /app/financeiro -> Attempt to save a financial entry without an amount -> See validation error preventing save

user_interactions: View rebranded Welcome overlay on login
